description: Given a string s, return the number of characters in s that are decimal digits, i.e. characters between '0' and '9' inclusive.
notes: VERINA counts the digits as the length of the filtered character list. The Dafny spec counts them as the sum of the multiplicities of '0'..'9' in multiset(s), which is the same number and which the verifier can evaluate on the concrete test strings.
